name: @agent-engine/tool-karos-landing
description: Landing Builder (s6, RFC-07) sandboxed tooling — template copy, a write-fenced site writer, the Layer 1 deterministic gate (token drift/font fidelity/brand lint/structure/carry-forward), and the Layer 2 Playwright render check. `engine/template/` is read-only; every write is structurally bounded to one client's `OUTPUT_PATH/site`.
